description: This file defines a mock class WebAudioPlayerTaskFactoryMock for unit testing, which implements the IWebAudioPlayerTaskFactory interface. It provides mock methods for creating various WebAudioPlayer tasks, such as play, pause, stop, setCaps, etc., used in testing WebAudioPlayer behavior within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerTaskFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock class implementing IWebAudioPlayerTaskFactory for testing WebAudioPlayer task creation methods.
